architecture.approach: Add an mdBook under docs/ built by CI. Three committed Node scripts follow the repository's existing scripts/ convention: generate the provider matrix and crate index from the catalogue and manifests, generate the error-code reference from the crates' source, and check for drift plus broken internal links. CI installs a pinned mdBook, builds the book, and runs both checks, so the site cannot claim a status the source contradicts.

components.name: docs/book.toml
components.description: mdBook configuration; no remote theme or assets.

components.name: docs/src/SUMMARY.md
components.description: Landing, crate index, provider matrix, error reference, upgrade guide.

components.name: docs/src/introduction.md
components.description: What the ecosystem is and how to read the site.

components.name: docs/src/upgrading.md
components.description: 0.x-to-1.0 policy and where breaking changes are recorded.

components.name: scripts/docs-matrix.js
components.description: Generates the crate index and provider matrix; --check fails on drift.

components.name: scripts/docs-errors.js
components.description: Generates the stable error-code reference from source.

components.name: scripts/docs-check.js
components.description: Drift check plus internal link check over docs/src.

components.name: .github/workflows/ci.yml
components.description: Docs job: pinned mdBook, build, then both checks.

dataModel.flowDescription: docs-matrix.js reads the catalogue index and each crate manifest, writes crates.md and provider-matrix.md, and with --check compares the regenerated text to disk. docs-errors.js scans the error enums for documented XX-* codes and writes errors.md. docs-check.js runs both in check mode and verifies every relative link in docs/src resolves inside it. Output is deterministic: stable ordering, no timestamps.

securityConsiderations.description: The build fetches no remote theme or asset; it works offline once mdBook is installed.
Generated pages are reproducible so the drift check is stable across machines.
The docs job stays inside the existing CI budget; mdBook is cached.

performanceConsiderations.strategy: Pinned prebuilt mdBook binary with a cache, and two Node passes over a small tree.

dependencies.name: mdbook
dependencies.notes: CI tool, pinned; not a crate dependency.

risks.description: cargo install mdbook is slow in CI.
risks.mitigation: Use a pinned prebuilt release and cache it.

risks.description: Generated documentation can drift from source.
risks.mitigation: The drift check runs in CI, not just locally.

risks.description: A docs site can over-scope into marketing.
risks.mitigation: The out-of-scope list and AC-006 keep it a static book.
